name: ext_aux

name: nth_of_bisim
statement: IsBisimulation R) (s₁ s₂) (ps : Path F) : (R s₁ s₂) → IsPath ps s₁ ∨ IsPath ps s₂ → iselect ps s₁ = iselect ps s₂ ∧ ∃ (a : _) (f f' : F.B a → M F), isubtree ps s₁ = M.mk ⟨a, f⟩ ∧ isubtree ps s₂ = M.mk ⟨a, f'⟩ ∧ ∀ i : F.B a, f i ~ f' i
